correctness.rationale: For any nonempty world set and finite nonempty family of S5 equivalence relations, the bundled operator preserves binary intersections iff at each world one agent cell equals the intersection of all agent cells: necessity applies meet preservation to the finitely many sets that are individual cells; sufficiency identifies the bundle with the ordinary relational box of the intersection relation. For two agents local minimum is exactly comparability of overlapping blocks. The join-component proof uniquely isolates common-block or oriented indiscrete/nontrivial partition cases, counting 2B_m-1 components of size m and proving the EGF/recurrence. A three-world crossing-partition frame is an explicit counterexample and sizes <=2 cannot fail. The packaged standard-library verifier enumerates all 44,168 ordered pairs for n<=6, checks all valuations for n<=4 and 3-agent analogues to n<=4, plus recurrence to n=8. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The new object is the class of fixed multi-agent S5 frames on which the disjunction of individual knowledge operators becomes normal. The proof supplies a necessary/sufficient pointwise minimum-cell criterion and, for two agents, a laminar intersection classification with an exact Bell-number exponential census. The original 2026 work axiomatizes the bundle on all S5 frames, whereas the 2021 predecessor gives nonnormality in general; neither inspected relevant section establishes the fixed-frame equivalence or the exact enumeration. The recent combinatorial partition reference studies different nested block structures. Published-finding and historical-claim comparisons produced no covering theorem. Uninspected text in the 2023 article, alternative neighborhood-filter terminology and inaccessible sequence database query remain residual risks.
residual_risks: The full 2023 Synthese article was not materially accessible beyond first-page preview and abstract, so an equivalent local-minimal-neighborhood condition elsewhere in that text cannot be excluded.
A direct OEIS sequence lookup could not be retrieved; an existing integer-sequence entry or table under a combinatorial alias may cover the numerical census.

Equivalent general filter/neighborhood or partition-incidence results under older terminology may imply either characterization or generating function; searches cannot establish their universal absence.

value.rationale: This resolves the naturally motivated frame-level question of exactly when the generally nonnormal epistemic someone-knows bundle regains normal Kripke semantics and coincides with distributed knowledge, at all modal nesting depths. For two agents it gives a complete natural classification of information partitions and a nontrivial all-size Bell-number census of precisely the satisfying labeled frames, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The sharp three-world failure boundary explains the smallest necessary information crossing. These data can support counting finite epistemic representations and understanding when bundled inference recovers conjunction closure; broader complexity claims are not made.
